name: wry
description_en: Cross-platform WebView library in Rust for Tauri.
readme_excerpt: Wry is a cross-platform WebView rendering library. The webview requires a running event loop and a window type that implements [HasWindowHandle], or a gtk container widget if you need to support X11 and Wayland. You can use a windowing library like [tao] or [winit]. Examples This example leverages the [HasWindowHandle] and supports Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and Linux (X11 Only).
